catalysts.title: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on October 19 and October 28, 2026

findings.summary: The Federal Reserve Board released minutes of its October 19 and October 28, 2026 meetings on the discount rate charged to depository institutions through the discount window. The release notes the discount rate process is separate from the FOMC's federal funds target setting.

catalysts.title: Greenwich Rx Issues Voluntary Nationwide Recall  of Compounded Sterile Products Due to Lack of Sterility Assurance

findings.summary: Greenwich Rx, a 503A compounding pharmacy in Tomball, Texas, announced a voluntary nationwide recall of specific lots of compounded sterile products within beyond-use dates, citing potential lack of sterility assurance following an FDA inspection. No adverse events have been reported to date; affected products were dispensed nationwide between August 10 and September 21, 2026, including products compounded for Clove Rx.

catalysts.title: Statement on Deramiocel BLA for Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy

findings.summary: FDA issued a complete response letter to Capricor for the deramiocel BLA for Duchenne muscular dystrophy, citing data integrity deficiencies in Study HOPE-3 and finding the evidence does not meet the approval standard. FDA also issued a Regulatory Responsibility Letter dated November 20, 2026 related to BIMO inspection observations.

catalysts.title: Report on the State of Pharmaceutical Quality

findings.summary: FDA's Office of Pharmaceutical Quality published its annual Report on the State of Pharmaceutical Quality, describing U.S. drug supply chain quality data and trends, and linked prior-year editions (2018–2024). The page names no specific company.

catalysts.title: Generic Drug User Fee Amendments

findings.summary: FDA's GDUFA program page restates GDUFA III reauthorization through September 2027, publishes FY 2026 and FY 2027 user fee rates (FY 2027 ANDA fee $375,684), and provides general fee payment and administrative instructions.

catalysts.title: Breckenridge Pharmaceutical, Inc. Issues Voluntary Nationwide Consumer-Level Recall of One Lot of Propranolol Hydrochloride Extended-Release Capsules, USP, 60 mg, Due to Potential Metal Contamination

findings.summary: Breckenridge Pharmaceutical is voluntarily recalling to the consumer level one lot (PK25110035, exp. May 2029) of Propranolol Hydrochloride Extended-Release Capsules USP 60 mg, 100-count bottles, due to potential metal contamination that could cause soft tissue lacerations. No related adverse events reported to date; product was distributed nationwide October 26 to November 4, 2026.

catalysts.title: SEC Issues Proposal to Restructure the Consolidated Audit Trail

findings.summary: The SEC announced a proposal to restructure the Consolidated Audit Trail, a market surveillance data system. Only the headline was retrieved, so the proposal's details are unknown.

catalysts.title: First Generic Drug Approvals

findings.summary: FDA published its 2026 year-to-date running table of first generic drug approvals (ANDAs), listing 91 entries from January through September 2026 with applicant, brand, and indication details. The table is a periodic compilation of previously issued approvals rather than a new company-specific action.

catalysts.title: Office of Infectious Diseases Research Activities

findings.summary: FDA's Office of Infectious Diseases page describes antimicrobial resistance research, announces FY2027 Broad Agency Announcement Day on December 8, 2026, and lists BAA submissions due January 22, 2027. No company-specific action or financial effect is stated.

catalysts.title: Ogle Cattle Company, Inc. - 713311 - 09/05/2025

findings.summary: FDA Center for Veterinary Medicine issued a warning letter to Ogle Cattle Company, a Texas cattle feedlot, citing cattle sold for slaughter with drug residues above tolerance and extralabel use of ceftiofur and enrofloxacin drugs, based on inspections in April to June 2025. The letter is dated September 5, 2025, though the published date is November 20, 2026.

catalysts.title: Stephen J. Fallon, Ph.D. - 728673 - 11/13/2026

findings.summary: FDA CBER responded to a clinical investigator's reply to an August 27, 2026 warning letter, stating the September 2, 2026 response did not fully resolve the issues because the corrective action plan was incomplete. The investigator must submit an implemented comprehensive CAPA plan before participating in any future FDA-regulated clinical investigation.

catalysts.title: Stephen J. Fallon, Ph.D. - 728673 - 08/27/2026

findings.summary: FDA CBER issued a warning letter to Dr. Stephen J. Fallon, a clinical investigator, citing informed consent, IRB approval, protocol-adherence, and recordkeeping violations found in a June 2025 BIMO inspection of Study CLS-003 (an INSTI HIV Self-Test study). The letter is addressed to an individual investigator and names no public company.

catalysts.title: SEC Charges Indianapolis-Based Backward Hat Capital and Its Co-Founders With $560 Million Dollar Offering Fraud and Obtains Emergency Relief

findings.summary: The SEC announced charges against Indianapolis-based Backward Hat Capital and its co-founders over an alleged $560 million offering fraud, and said it obtained emergency relief. Only the headline was retrieved; no body text was available.

catalysts.title: Office of Health Advancement (OHA) Guidance Documents

findings.summary: FDA's Office of Health Advancement (formerly the Office of the Chief Medical Officer) published a general landing page describing its role and the guidance documents it issues on combination products, pediatric products, rare disease incentive programs, clinical trials, and medical countermeasures. No specific new guidance, decision, or company action is announced.

catalysts.title: Office of Health Advancement (OHA) Guidance Documents

findings.summary: FDA's Office of Health Advancement (formerly OCMO) published a general webpage describing its role and the non-binding nature of its guidance documents, covering combination products, pediatric products, rare disease incentives, clinical trials, and medical countermeasures. No specific new guidance or action is announced.

catalysts.title: Roster of the Vaccines and Related Biological Products Advisory Committee

findings.summary: FDA posted the roster of the Vaccines and Related Biological Products Advisory Committee, noting 8 vacancies and requesting nominations for committee members. The roster lists current members, an alternate industry representative from Merck & Co., and an FDA contact.

catalysts.title: Breckenridge Pharmaceutical, Inc. Issues Voluntary Nationwide Consumer-Level Recall of One Lot of Propranolol Hydrochloride Extended-Release Capsules, USP, 60 mg, Due to Potential Metal Contamination

findings.summary: Breckenridge Pharmaceutical voluntarily recalled to the consumer level one lot (PK25110035) of Propranolol Hydrochloride Extended-Release Capsules USP 60 mg, manufactured by Adare Pharma Solutions, due to potential metal contamination that could cause soft tissue lacerations. No adverse events related to the recall were reported to date; the lot was distributed nationwide between October 26 and November 4, 2026.

catalysts.title: Early Alert: Heraeus Medical Components Removes Vascular Guidewires

findings.summary: FDA issued an Early Alert that Heraeus Medevio is voluntarily recalling certain Navilyst, Spectrum, and Arrow Marked vascular guidewire lots due to hydrophilic coating that may swell inconsistently, clump, and flake, risking particle embolization. Heraeus reported no serious injuries or deaths as of November 5, 2026.

No adverse events have been reported to date; the products were dispensed nationwide between August 10 and September 21, 2026.
